title: HAKODA Solo Exhibtion「Force of Distance」
author: No Name
content:
■Profile
 Hakodaは1998年生まれで、大阪府出身の画家。幼少期から漫画の絵を非常に好んだ彼は、2022年から福岡を拠点に画家としての活動を始める。活動開始時から、自身が音楽を聴いて踊ることからインスピレーションを受け作品を制作している。人型のキャラクターに自分が踊る時の感覚を込めて描くことで、彼の「踊り」を絵画で表現している。

■アーティストからのコメント
こんにちは。Hakodaです。久しぶりに個展を開催いたします。今回の個展では以前から描いていた体の動き、「踊り」の表現に新たな要素を加えた作品を展示します。皆さんが作品をどのように感じてくれるのかとても楽しみです。よろしくお願い致します。

 Hakoda was born in 1998 and is a painter from Osaka Prefecture. He has loved manga illustrations since childhood, and in 2022, he began his career as a painter based in Fukuoka. From the start of his career, he has been creating works inspired by listening to music and dancing. By incorporating the sensation of dancing into his human-shaped characters, he expresses his “dance” through painting.

■Artist's Comment
Hello, this is Hakoda. I am pleased to announce that I will be holding a solo exhibition after a long hiatus. In this exhibition, I will be showcasing works that incorporate new elements into the expression of bodily movement and “dance,” which I have been exploring in my art for some time. I am very excited to see how you will perceive these works. Thank you for your support.
